messages:
Jas: Planning X + LinkedIn for the Benchmark + webinar. Want to lock posts today. Who can own visuals and captions? :spiral_calendar: 
Priya: I can do visuals (hero + 2 stat cards + short vertical clip). Need final copy + logos. Will deliver by 2pm PT.
Omar: Draft copy here: https://redwood.internal/marketing/bench-web-social (please comment). Two headline variants for split testing.
Zoe: Suggested posting window: X thread Tue 08:30 PT, LinkedIn post Tue 10:30 PT, Reminder on Wed 09:00 PT. Works for synced PR outreach.
Jas: Good — PR needs the first tweet to include the key stat and a link to the embargoed press doc. Keep numbers exact and source cited.
Omar: Copy (short):
A) "Benchmark: Serving optimizations cut per-token spend by up to 3x. See how — join the webinar. https://redwood.ai/webinar"
B) "Lower latency, lower cost: our benchmark shows practical inference wins. Register now: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Priya: We'll need alt text for each image and a 250-char trimmed LinkedIn version. Can someone confirm the 3x claim is cleared by product/legal?
Zoe: @legal please review claim language. @product can you confirm the benchmark methodology link is public?
ops-bot: Reminder: social scheduler needs ISO times and proof of legal + product ack before queuing. Use `--meta source=social campaign=bench_q3` in scheduler.
Jas: Routing notes: include UTM params so leads route to webinar queue. Proposed UTMs: `utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bench_q3`. Also add hidden field `campaign_source=social-bench-q3` to form.
Omar: Engagement plan: growth team to reply to top 10 comments within first 4 hours. If thread engagement > 150 replies, escalate to comms for extra replies. Also schedule a pinned follow-up with main insight and CTA.
Priya: Asset checklist: hero_1200x628.png, stat_card_1.png, stat_card_2.png, vertical_clip.mp4, alt_text.txt. Uploading to Figma now.
Zoe: Also request community to reshare on LinkedIn company page + 2 employee posts on day of launch. Growth to compile a reshare list.
growth-bot: Automated: predicted optimal X time for maximum engagement = 08:45 PT (based on past 30-day trends). Queue has 1 slot at 08:45.
Jas: Ok lock times as 2025-09-09T15:45:00Z for X first tweet (this maps to 08:45 PT) and 2025-09-09T17:30:00Z for LinkedIn. Post commands we'll use:
`publish --channel x --time "2025-09-09T15:45:00Z" --text-file copy_x.txt --media hero_1200x628.png --utm "bench_q3"`
`publish --channel linkedin --time "2025-09-09T17:30:00Z" --text-file copy_ln.txt --media hero_1200x628.png --trim 250 --utm "bench_q3"`
Omar: Dropping final copy here for approvals: "Our benchmark shows serving optimizations reduce per-token spend by up to 3x while keeping output quality. Join our webinar to see configs, results, and tips: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Zoe: Approved by product for methodology. @legal please add reaction when claim cleared.
legal-team: (via DM) Reviewing the 3x wording — please include the comparison baseline in the landing page.
Jas: Once legal reacts, I'll queue in scheduler and ping ops to make sure form hidden field is mapped to `webinar_bench_q3` in CRM.
ops-bot: Note: mapping reminder sent to CRM team. Expect update in 2 hours.
Priya: Assets uploaded. File names in Figma: hero_final.png, stat1_final.png, stat2_final.png, clip_9_16.mp4, alt_texts.md.
growth-bot: Tip: add a short poll in the X thread 24h after launch to boost engagement.
Omar: Engagement follow-ups: team to monitor first 6 hours; compile top 10 questions and route product Qs to Zoe. If >250 signups in 12h, trigger SDR follow-up email sequence.
Jas: Great. Final checklist to close here:
- [ ] Legal ack (legal-team)
- [ ] Product ack (Zoe)
- [ ] Assets uploaded (Priya)
- [ ] UTM + hidden field wired (ops)
- [ ] Scheduler ISO times added (Jas)
- [ ] Growth engagement plan set (growth)
Omar: I'll watch for legal reaction and post final ISO times if any change. Thanks team! :rocket:
